title: ライトが当たらない場所で

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A winning concert is a stage of dreams. Every runner longs to stand in the spotlight and sing "thank you" to the fans who cheered for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that dream only comes true for a select few. The harsh reality is that many will only ever stand on stage as backup dancers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day during concert practice, Smart Falcon's classmate expresses disdain for learning backup dancer choreography.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Falcon makes the case for giving 100% no matter who's in the spotlight as a way of showing appreciation to the fans, but her plea falls on deaf ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They all dream of standing center stage. The glamor of the spotlight wouldn't be the same if they didn't have to earn it, but fierce competition also breeds tension.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Falcon begins to imagine a world without centers or backup dancers, one in which they could all stand on stage as equals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's when Light Hello shows up. Calling herself an event producer, she pitches a plan to bring back a different type of concert—the Grand Concert!
